name: Wall shackles
description: Prison shackles for a wall: a riveted iron plate about 0.9 m up with two heavy rings on staples, one chain running down the wall and along the floor to a pair of manacles lying open on the ground, the other hanging to a pair of rusty cuffs just clear of the floor. The back is flat, to stand against a wall.

provenance.prompt: An iron ring plate with two chains and manacles for a wall, about 0.8 × 0.15 × 1 m.
